question: Which protective power is asked to stand on the left limb at the time of love?
premises: The time of love is specified.
Śṛṅkhalā is asked to stand there.
inference: Śṛṅkhalā is invoked to stand on the left limb at the time of love.
uncertainties: The role of paścime in this context is unclear.
plain_english: And at the time of love, may Śṛṅkhalā stand on the left limb, in the west.
